description:
Learn how to play Ken from Street Fighter 6! 

Ken is an aggressive character with a ton of powerful kicks to control space on the screen, and plenty of ways to rush the opponent down and overwhelm their defenses.

Learn the character’s basic controls and moves to prepare for Street Fighter 6. Street Fighter 6 launches on June 2 on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam!
